# Nuevo Automations

> Nuevo Automations (Nuevo Automations FZE LLC) is a marketing agency registered in Sharjah Publishing City Free Zone, United Arab Emirates, founded by Nawaf Allahham. It focuses on premium wellness and supplement brands selling online in the UAE, running Meta (Instagram and Facebook) click-to-WhatsApp ads that send buyers to a WhatsApp chat instead of a landing page, and sells M2S (Message to Sale): an AI sales assistant that replies on WhatsApp in English or Arabic, closes the sale in the chat, follows up on abandoned carts, unpaid payment links and quiet leads, and sends a monthly results report.

Key facts:
- Serves businesses across the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the other emirates), in English and Arabic.
- M2S runs on the client's own WhatsApp number and on OrcaFlo, a WhatsApp AI platform Nuevo Automations built and runs itself.
- The AI never invents prices or products; anything it can't answer is handed to the client's team with a chat summary.
- Pricing: one fixed monthly fee, quoted in writing after a free 30-minute audit. No public price list. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta and is not part of the fee.
- No guaranteed results. Partners report 50–60% more revenue from the same traffic after full rollout, with no extra headcount, and the best return on ad spend seen, on client Khaleej ParaPharma, is 30x, not a typical result; individual results vary. Clients get a monthly M2S Results report showing conversations, orders, revenue and what follow-ups recovered.
- Peak Labs (supplements, UAE) reports a 90x faster first reply, 53% more orders a month and 74% of chats handled without a person (figures as of October 2026).

## What Is M2S? Message-to-Sale Explained | Nuevo Automations

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/m2s/

M2S turns ad messages into sales: click-to-WhatsApp ads, instant AI replies in English and Arabic, in-chat checkout, follow-ups and a monthly report.

M2S (Message to Sale) is a done-for-you service from Nuevo Automations, a Sharjah-registered marketing agency. We run Meta click-to-WhatsApp ads and Google search ads, and an AI sales assistant replies to every message in seconds in English or Arabic, takes the order or booking in the chat, follows up with abandoned carts, unpaid links and leads that went silent, and reports the results every month.

Q: Who is M2S for?
A: UAE businesses that sell through conversations: online stores, clinics, salons and spas, real estate, education and training, and restaurants. It suits businesses that already run Meta or Google ads, or are ready to, and want more of those messages to turn into sales.

Q: Do I keep my own WhatsApp number?
A: Yes. The AI sales assistant runs on your own WhatsApp number, and your team can keep using the WhatsApp app to step in at any time.

Q: What does the M2S assistant do when it doesn't know an answer?
A: It never invents prices or products. Anything it can't answer goes straight to your team with an instant WhatsApp alert and a summary of the chat.

Q: How is M2S priced?
A: One fixed monthly fee, based on your ad budget, your channels and how many products or services we load, quoted in writing after a free 30-minute audit. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta or Google.

Q: How do I know M2S is working?
A: Every chat is tagged with the ad it came from, and you get a monthly M2S Results report: conversations, orders, revenue, reply speed and the revenue recovered by follow-ups.

## WhatsApp Business API Automation, UAE | Nuevo Automations

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/whatsapp-automation-uae/

WhatsApp Business API automation in the UAE on your own number: the 24-hour reply window, Meta-approved templates, opt-in and opt-out, handled for you.

WhatsApp automation means replying to, qualifying and following up with customers on WhatsApp by software rather than by hand. For a business, it runs on the official WhatsApp Business API, which allows an AI assistant, team inboxes and Meta-approved message templates. Messages outside the 24-hour customer-service window must use those templates, and customers must be able to opt out.

Q: Do I lose my WhatsApp chat history when moving to the API?
A: Your customers keep the same number and their side of the conversation. During the audit we check your current setup and explain what moves over before anything changes.

Q: Can my team still use the WhatsApp app?
A: Yes. M2S runs on the same number through the official API, and your team can still open the WhatsApp app on it to read and reply to any chat.

Q: What is the 24-hour customer-service window?
A: After a customer's last message, a business can reply freely for 24 hours. After that, it can only restart the conversation with a message template Meta has approved. We write and set those up for you.

Q: How do customers opt out of follow-ups?
A: They just say stop. Anyone who does is never messaged again, follow-ups never go out at night, and each customer gets at most one sequence per week.

Q: Will my click-to-WhatsApp ads open chats on this number?
A: Yes. The ads we run open chats on your own number, each tagged with the ad that started it, and sales made in the chat are reported back to Meta.

## Instagram DM Automation, Dubai | Nuevo Automations

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/instagram-dm-automation-dubai/

Instagram DM automation in Dubai: ads that open DMs or WhatsApp, comments and story replies turned into DMs, and the sale moved to WhatsApp to pay.

Instagram DM automation means answering direct messages, story replies and post comments automatically, usually with an AI assistant. It covers ads that open a DM, comments that trigger a private reply, and replies to stories. For businesses that close sales on WhatsApp, the DM can hand the customer over to WhatsApp for the payment link or booking.

Q: Can it reply to Instagram comments with a private message?
A: Yes. When someone comments a question like "price?" on a post or reel, the assistant sends them a private DM with the answer.

Q: Should my ads open Instagram DMs or WhatsApp?
A: It depends on the audience and the product. DMs suit people still browsing; WhatsApp suits people ready to buy, because checkout runs there. We often test both and compare sales in the monthly report.

Q: Why move the conversation to WhatsApp?
A: Because the payment link, cash-on-delivery order, booking and follow-ups run on WhatsApp in M2S. The assistant offers the move at the buying point and carries the context across.

Q: Does it reply to story replies?
A: Yes. Replies and questions on your stories are answered in the DM in seconds, in English or Arabic.

## AI Sales Chatbot Development, UAE | Nuevo Automations

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/ai-chatbot-development-uae/

How we build AI sales chatbots in the UAE: trained on your products, prices and policies, with guardrails, English and Arabic, and testing before launch.

An AI sales chatbot is a chat assistant that answers buying questions, recommends products and closes the sale in the conversation. A well-built one works only from the business's own catalogue, prices and policies, refuses to make anything up, replies in the customer's language, and passes anything it cannot answer to a person with a summary of the chat.

Q: What do you need from us to build the chatbot?
A: Your products or services, prices, delivery or booking terms, opening hours and policies such as returns. We turn that into the information the assistant answers from and check it with you.

Q: Can it make up a price or a discount?
A: No. It only quotes prices from your list. If something isn't there, it tells the customer a colleague will confirm and sends your team a chat summary.

Q: How do you test the chatbot before launch?
A: We run real questions from your inbox through it, in English and Arabic, check each answer against your information and fix any gaps before customers use it.

Q: Does it work on our website as well as WhatsApp?
A: Yes. The same assistant can run on WhatsApp and your website chat, from the same products, prices and policies.

## CRM Automation & Sales Pipeline, UAE | Nuevo Automations

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/crm-automation-uae/

A WhatsApp sales pipeline for UAE businesses: stages from new lead to ordered, lead routing, instant staff alerts and follow-up rules your team can see.

CRM automation is software keeping your customer records and sales stages up to date without manual entry. In M2S, every WhatsApp chat becomes a lead that moves through four stages as the AI assistant talks to the customer: New lead, Qualified, Checkout started and Ordered, with staff alerts and follow-up rules attached to each.

Q: What are the pipeline stages?
A: New lead, Qualified, Checkout started and Ordered. Leads move between them automatically as the assistant talks to the customer, and your team can see each lead's stage.

Q: How does the pipeline route leads to the right person?
A: By rules we agree with you, such as product, area, language or the ad that started the chat. The chosen person gets a WhatsApp alert with a summary of the chat.

Q: Do we have to replace our current CRM?
A: No. M2S has its own pipeline, and where you already use a CRM we can send leads and stage changes to it as well.

Q: When do pipeline follow-ups stop?
A: As soon as the customer replies or buys, or says stop. None go out at night, and no customer gets more than one sequence a week.

AI receptionist for UAE service businesses: checks availability, books, reschedules and cancels on WhatsApp, takes deposits and sends reminders.

An AI receptionist is an assistant that handles appointment requests in chat the way a front desk would. It reads your calendar's free times, offers slots, books them, reschedules or cancels when asked, takes a deposit if you require one and sends reminders before the visit. Questions outside its information go to a person.

Q: Which calendar does it book into?
A: It reads free times from your calendar and writes confirmed bookings back to it. We connect your calendar during setup and check the rules for each service's length.

Q: Can customers reschedule or cancel by themselves?

Q: Can it take a deposit before confirming?
A: Yes, if you want one. It sends a card payment link from your payment provider and confirms the booking once it's paid.

Q: Does it take bookings at night?
A: Yes. Requests that arrive after hours are answered in seconds and booked into real free times, and your team gets a WhatsApp alert for each new booking.

An integration is a connection that lets two systems share data automatically, through an API or a webhook. For M2S it means products and prices come in from your store or sheet, free times from your calendar, and payment confirmations from your payment provider, while orders, leads and bookings go back out without anyone copying them.

Q: Do I need n8n, Make or Zapier to use M2S?

Q: Which tools can you connect?
A: Typically your online store, your payment provider, Google Sheets, your calendar and your CRM. Shopify connects directly, and other stores connect through our API.

Q: Are integrations priced separately?
A: No. Connecting your tools is part of M2S setup and included in the fixed monthly fee. We don't sell automation projects on their own.

Q: What happens if an integration breaks?
A: We watch for failed runs while we run M2S and fix them, for example when an app renames a field or an access token expires.

## WhatsApp & Meta Ads Guides for UAE Brands | Nuevo Automations

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/

Guides for UAE brands on WhatsApp Business API pricing, click-to-WhatsApp ads, supplement advertising rules, cart recovery and tracking sales from chats.

## WhatsApp Business API Pricing in the UAE, 2026 | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-business-api-pricing-uae/

How Meta charges for WhatsApp Business API messages in the UAE in 2026: per-message billing, the October 2026 service-message change and free ad windows.

Since 1 July 2025, Meta bills the WhatsApp Business API per delivered message, not per conversation. The price depends on the message category (marketing, utility, authentication or service) and on the country code of the customer who receives it. The UAE is its own market on Meta's rate card. From 1 October 2026, each business number gets 1,000 free service messages a month and pays for service messages beyond that. Chats that start from a click-to-WhatsApp ad open a free entry point window in which Meta doesn't charge for messages.

Q: Is the WhatsApp Business app free?
A: Yes. The free WhatsApp Business app on your phone has no per-message charges. Per-message pricing applies to the WhatsApp Business API (the Business Platform), which you need for an AI assistant, team inboxes, ad tracking and scheduled follow-ups.

Q: Do I pay when a customer messages my business?
A: No. Meta only charges for messages your business sends that are delivered. Messages customers send you are free.

Q: Which country's rate applies to a UAE business?
A: The rate of the country code of the customer receiving the message. Messages to +971 numbers use the UAE rate; messages to customers abroad use their country's rate.

Q: Are replies to customers still free after October 2026?
A: Each business number gets 1,000 free service messages a month. Beyond that, service messages are charged at Meta's published rate, except for eligible government and non-profit accounts.

Q: How long is the free window after a click-to-WhatsApp ad?
A: Meta's developer documentation says the free entry point window can stay open for up to 7 days once you reply within 24 hours; its marketing pages say 72 hours. During it, Meta doesn't charge for template or service messages to that customer.

## Click-to-WhatsApp Ads: A Guide for UAE Brands | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/click-to-whatsapp-ads/

How click-to-WhatsApp ads work on Instagram and Facebook, when they beat a landing page, how to set them up and how to report the sales they make.

A click-to-WhatsApp ad is an Instagram or Facebook ad whose button opens a WhatsApp chat with your business, often with a pre-filled first message. It works best when buyers have questions before they pay, such as dosage, delivery or authenticity, which is common for premium wellness products in the UAE. The ad only starts the conversation: the sale depends on replying within seconds and on reporting chat sales back to Meta so it can find more buyers.

Q: Do click-to-WhatsApp ads work on Instagram?
A: Yes. They run on Instagram, Facebook and Messenger placements. Tapping the button opens WhatsApp on the buyer's phone with your business number.

Q: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API for click-to-WhatsApp ads?
A: No, the ads can open chats on the WhatsApp Business app. You need the API to reply automatically, tag each chat with its ad, run follow-ups and report sales back to Meta.

Q: Which campaign objective should I use?
A: Engagement, Leads or Sales can all use WhatsApp as the conversion location. Once you send sales back through the Conversions API, a Sales objective lets Meta optimise for buyers rather than for conversations.

Q: How fast do I need to reply?
A: As fast as possible, ideally within seconds. The buyer has just tapped the ad and has WhatsApp open; a reply hours later usually loses the sale.

## Advertising Supplements in the UAE: 2026 Rules | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/advertising-supplements-uae/

Meta's rules for supplement ads, the UAE's November 2026 medical-advertising clarification and the influencer ban, and how to keep WhatsApp sales chats compliant.

On Meta, ads for dietary, health and herbal supplements must target people aged 18 or over, can't use before-and-after images or make people feel bad about their bodies, and can't promise a specific result in a set time. In the UAE, the Emirates Drug Establishment said on 18 November 2026 that every advertisement for a medical product needs its approval before it runs, on any channel including social media, and that influencers may not promote medical products. Supplements have their own registration and approval routes, which differ by product and emirate, so check your product's classification with the regulator before you advertise.

Q: Can I target supplement ads to under-18s on Instagram?
A: No. Meta requires ads for dietary, health and herbal supplements, and weight-loss products, to target people aged 18 or over.

Q: Do supplement ads in the UAE need approval?
A: Often, yes. Medical product ads need Emirates Drug Establishment approval before they run, and supplements have their own registration and approval routes that can differ by emirate. Check your product's classification with the regulator.

Q: Can influencers promote supplements in the UAE?
A: Influencers may not promote medical products, under the Emirates Drug Establishment's November 2026 clarification. Whether a supplement falls under that depends on its classification, and paid creators also need the UAE Media Council's advertiser permit.

Q: Are before-and-after photos allowed in Meta wellness ads?
A: No. Meta lists before-and-after weight-loss photos as an example of content that creates negative self-perception, which its health and wellness standards don't allow.

## WhatsApp Abandoned Cart Recovery: How It Works | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/whatsapp-abandoned-cart-recovery/

How to recover abandoned carts on WhatsApp: what you need, when to send, what to write in English and Arabic, what it costs and how to measure it.

WhatsApp abandoned cart recovery means sending an approved WhatsApp template to a shopper who left items in their cart, with a way to finish the order. You need the WhatsApp Business API, the shopper's number and consent from checkout, a Meta-approved marketing template, and a link from your store that tells the system a cart was left. Send the first reminder within about an hour, at most one more the next day, stop the moment they reply or buy, and never at night.

Q: Can I send cart reminders from the free WhatsApp Business app?
A: Not automatically. Automated reminders need the WhatsApp Business API and a Meta-approved template.

Q: Is an abandoned-cart message marketing or utility?
A: Meta treats cart reminders as marketing messages, so they need a marketing template and are charged at the marketing rate.

Q: How many reminders should I send?
A: One within about an hour, and at most one more the next day. Stop as soon as the shopper replies, buys or asks you to stop.

Q: Do I need consent to message shoppers on WhatsApp?
A: Yes. WhatsApp requires opt-in. Ask for the number at checkout with a clear statement that you'll message them about their order, and honour every stop request.

## How to Track Sales From WhatsApp Ads (Real ROAS) | Nuevo

URL: https://nuevoautomations.com/guides/track-whatsapp-ad-sales/

Why Ads Manager shows conversations, not sales, for WhatsApp ads, and how to send chat sales back to Meta with the Conversions API to see real return on ad spend.

Ads Manager can't see what happens inside a WhatsApp chat, so for click-to-WhatsApp ads it reports conversations started, not sales. To see real return on ad spend, capture the click ID WhatsApp passes with each chat that starts from an ad, and when that chat turns into an order, send a Purchase event with the order value to Meta's Conversions API. Meta then attributes the sale to the ad and can optimise for buyers instead of chatters.

Q: Can Meta Pixel track WhatsApp sales?
A: No. The pixel only runs on web pages. Sales made inside WhatsApp chats need to be sent to Meta through the Conversions API, tied to the ad's click ID.

Q: What is ctwa_clid?
A: It's the click ID the WhatsApp Business API passes with the first message of a chat that started from a click-to-WhatsApp ad. Sending it back with a Purchase event lets Meta attribute the sale to that ad.

Q: Should I optimise click-to-WhatsApp ads for conversations or sales?
A: For sales, once purchases are reaching Meta. Optimising for conversations teaches Meta to find people who start chats, not people who buy.

Q: Is Meta's reported ROAS accurate?
A: It's an estimate based on its attribution window and modelling. Compare it every month with your store's own delivered orders.
